item.title: Cemetery and Closed Churchyard Maintenance Contract
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 8,000 Status: active Deadline: 2027-01-05T23:59:59Z
Bilton Parish Council invites tenders for the carrying out of cemetery maintenance within the Parish Cemetery and Closed Churchyard. The schedule of works includes: 18 cuts to main church and adjacent cemetery during the growing period - to include the collection of mower clippings and strimming to all head stones and kerbs. Clippings to be removed from site. 3 cuts to all hedge rows - with pre, mid and end season prunes as needed. All brash to be removed from site - with extra cuts if agreed upon inspection. 9 cuts to large rear grassed area (new burial ground at rear of cemetery) - clippings to be spread for neat appearance. 9 monthly weed control applications to all required appears to include gravel paths, kerbs, building parameters, planted and hedge boards, and selective grave areas. Full site litter pick on every visit, litter to be placed in onsite bin. Level graves as on inspection and to include supplying topsoil and seed. Crown lifting to any branches or tree limbs as requires, brash to be removed from site. Maintain external cenotaph as require for appearance.
